item.title: Product Hunt Daily | 2026-11-06
item.description:
1. Glasshand

Tagline: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
Description: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI agents, cloud hardware, remote iPhone, remote Mac, device rental, iOS testing, agent automation, cloud devices, AI infrastructure, mobile automation, secure wipe, headless devices, cloud phones, automated workflows
VotesCount: 🔺370
Featured: Yes
CreatedAt: 2026-11-05 08:01 AM (UTC)

2. Rerun

Tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
Description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI agents, AI automation, open source, self-hosted, AI workflow, multi-agent AI, autonomous AI, AI workspace, scheduled automation, AI safety, LLM integration, workflow orchestration
VotesCount: 🔺248
Featured: Yes

3. Living Brain

Tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
Description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI memory, agentic AI, persistent memory, knowledge layer, interoperable, MCP, API, SDK, cross-platform AI, agent context, multi-model integration, intelligent reuse, evolving knowledge, Living Brain
VotesCount: 🔺243
Featured: Yes

4. Maritime

Tagline: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
Description: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

5. Pushary for Teams

Tagline: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
Description: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.
